# Image Inpainting — RunComfy Pro Pack

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — mask-driven image region replacement through RunComfy's Z-Image Turbo Inpaint: remove objects, complete scenes, or restyle a masked region while everything outside the mask stays pixel-identical. Documents the mask-first workflow (binary mask required), the preservation recipe, and when inpainting beats prompt-only edit routes. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @genmedia-labs. Honest caveats: paid RunComfy account, billed per generation; you must supply a binary mask up front — no mask, no edit; edges can need a second pass on high-contrast boundaries. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
